title: Oozy French Prawns Canelle Bananaleaf
description: A quick-fix sweet and gooey Lyon-style dish featuring raw frozen prawns cooked with banana leaf and cinnamon.
instructions: Place the banana leaf on a flat surface and spread a layer of sour cream or yogurt over it.
Gently place the frozen prawns in a single layer over the cream, making sure they are not overlapping.
Sprinkle cinnamon powder and saffron threads evenly over the prawns.
Wrap the banana leaf around the prawns to form a neat cylinder shape. The banana leaf will be hot so use tongs for handling.
Place the wrapped bundle in a pan or pot, ensuring that the lid is not completely sealed to allow steam to escape and cook from outside in.
Flip the banana leaf wrap over to ensure even cooking. Continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the prawns are cooked through and gooey.
